events.name: Mysterious Chest
events.intro: A heavy chest sits alone in the grass. It rattles once.

success.text: Treasure! It was full of shiny things.

failure.text: A Pokémon bursts out of the chest!

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Shady Dealer
events.intro: "Psst. Trade me one of yours and I'll give you something… stronger."

success.text: He hands over a Poké Ball with a wink.

events.name: Lost Pokémon
events.intro: A small Pokémon is crying by the path. Its trainer is nowhere to be seen.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Training Session
events.intro: A Black Belt offers to train your lead Pokémon.

success.text: Your lead grits its teeth and grows stronger!
A calm session. Your lead trusts you more.

events.name: Department Store Sale
events.intro: A pop-up stall: "Everything must go!"

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Vitamin Seller
events.intro: A man in sunglasses opens a crate of unlabeled bottles.

failure.text: They tasted awful. Your Pokémon sulk.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Fight or Flight
events.intro: A strong Pokémon guards something glowing.

success.text: You slip by and grab the item!

events.name: Berry Patch
events.intro: A berry bush, heavy with fruit. Something is munching on it.

events.name: Wandering Breeder
events.intro: A breeder offers to look after one of your Pokémon for a while.

success.text: It comes back glowing and happy, with a new trick.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Mysterious Challengers
events.intro: Three trainers on pedestals. "Pick your opponent!"

success.text: The strongest of them steps down.

events.name: Sleeping Giant
events.intro: A huge Snorlax is asleep across the path.

success.text: It munches happily and rolls aside. Something fell from its fur.

events.name: Fortune Teller
events.intro: "The cards know who waits at the gym…"

success.text: She describes the gym leader's whole team.
You work it out from the signs.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Department Store Haggle
events.intro: Price tags flip to red as a clerk waves you over.

success.text: You talk the price right down.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Shady Vitamin Dealer
events.intro: A crate of bottles. Some labels are… spelled wrong.

success.text: You spot the fakes and pick a real one.

events.name: Black Market
events.intro: A curtain parts. Goods no shop would sell.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Travelling Collector
events.intro: A collector peers at your Bag through a glass case.

success.text: A mystery item, wrapped in paper.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Pokémon Salesman
events.intro: "A Magikarp on a cushion! Only ₽500! It's a secret kind!"

failure.text: "Secret? It's a fish." You buy it anyway.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Bargain Bin
events.intro: A janitor tips over a bin of odds and ends.

success.text: Something good was buried in there!
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Chef's Tasting
events.intro: Steaming plates line a roadside table.

success.text: You win the cook-off! Free berries.

failure.text: Burnt. You help with the dishes.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Item Pawnshop
events.intro: A maid sits at a ledger. "Pawn something?"

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Ticket Tout
events.intro: "Ticket to a secret stop? Real, I swear."

success.text: It was real! Every "?" on this stage is revealed.
He hands it over for free.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Charm Peddler
events.intro: Lanterns sway over a cart of charms.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Mega Bazaar
events.intro: A shopfront glittering with strange stones.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Winstrate Family
events.intro: A whole family lines up. "Beat us all, back to back!"

success.text: The family sends out their best!
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: A Trainer's Test
events.intro: "Battle me with one Pokémon, and I'll teach it something."

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Double Trouble
events.intro: Twins hold hands. "We battle together!"

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Dojo Challenge
events.intro: A Black Belt bows. "Spar, or meditate?"

failure.text: You take a beating, but learn.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Rival Rematch
events.intro: Your rival runs up, out of breath. "Battle! Now!"

events.name: Battle Tower Floor
events.intro: Two conductors stand at a lift door. "All aboard for the next floor!"

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Youngster's Shorts
events.intro: "Like my shorts? They're comfy and easy to wear!"

success.text: He's so happy he gives you a Rare Candy.

events.name: Ace Trainer Bet
events.intro: An Ace Trainer flips a coin. "Bet on our battle?"

events.name: Gym Scout
events.intro: A guide points at the gym. "Want to know what's inside?"

success.text: You learn the leader's whole team.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Pokéathlon
events.intro: A track, hurdles and a cheering crowd.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Contest Hall
events.intro: Spotlights sweep the stage. "Beauty, Cool or Cute?"

success.text: You pick up a few tips.

events.name: Slumbering Snorlax
events.intro: Snoring shakes the ground.

success.text: It rolls over and drops something.

events.name: Glowing Guardian
events.intro: A strong Pokémon stands over a glowing item.

success.text: It trades the item for a snack.

events.name: Berries Abound
events.intro: A berry tree shakes with Pokémon.

events.name: Lost at Sea
events.intro: A swimmer waves from a drifting raft.

success.text: Safe! They give you a gift.

failure.text: The current is too strong. You barely make it.

events.name: Fiery Fallout
events.intro: Ash rains down. Fire Pokémon sleep in the warm haze.

success.text: The ash clears. Your party is tired.
Steam! A rare Fire Pokémon wants to come with you.

events.name: Uncommon Breed
events.intro: A strangely coloured Pokémon is eating quietly.

events.name: Pokémon Stampede
events.intro: A herd thunders towards you!

success.text: The herd parts around you. One stays.
You leap aside and catch one's eye.
You hide, but get trampled a bit.

events.name: Swarm
events.intro: Dozens of the same Pokémon fill the field.

events.name: Injured Pokémon
events.intro: A fainted wild Pokémon lies in the grass.

success.text: It wakes and nuzzles you. It wants to come along!
You catch it while it's down.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Egg Nest
events.intro: An unguarded nest holds one egg.

success.text: You tuck the Egg into your bag. It feels warm.

events.name: Legendary Shadow
events.intro: A huge silhouette moves in the fog. The air goes still.

failure.text: The shadow fades into the fog.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Fishing Spot
events.intro: "Borrow a rod? Old, Good or Super!"

events.name: Team Rocket Ambush
events.intro: A net drops from the trees! "Prepare for trouble!"

success.text: They grab the cash and blast off.
"The police are right behind me!" They flee, dropping something.

events.name: Team Aqua Dig
events.intro: Team Aqua grunts are digging up the shore.

events.name: Team Magma Heist
events.intro: Team Magma surrounds a smoking crate.

success.text: While they argue, you take the crate.

events.name: Galactic Survey
events.intro: A Galactic grunt waves a scanner. "Mind if I scan your party?"

success.text: "Then I'll take the data by force!"
You peek at their readings. Interesting!

events.name: Plasma Liberation
events.intro: "Liberate your Pokémon!" A Plasma grunt waves a banner.

success.text: "You're a prisoner of your own Pokémon!"

choices.label: Give them money for their cause

success.text: They pay you back double, oddly.

events.name: Flare Fashion
events.intro: Two grunts in red suits strike a pose.

events.name: Skull Squad
events.intro: Team Skull grunts spray graffiti. "Yo, what you lookin' at?"

success.text: Your rhymes win! They pay up.

failure.text: They laugh you off the stage.

events.name: Yell Fans
events.intro: Team Yell blocks the road with signs and noise.

success.text: Out-yelled! They let you through, impressed.

events.name: Star Squad Raid
events.intro: A Starmobile revs outside a Team Star base.

events.name: Rainbow Rocket
events.intro: A portal crackles. A villain boss steps through.

failure.text: The portal sucks something from your Bag.

events.name: Shadow Triad
events.intro: Three figures appear in a puff of smoke.

events.name: Ghetsis's Offer
events.intro: "Power, child. Take it."

events.name: Pickpocket
events.intro: Someone bumps into you and runs off with something!

success.text: You catch them and get it back, plus a bit extra.

events.name: Fake Nurse
events.intro: A nurse offers to heal your team. Her smile is… off.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Pokémon Center Lady
events.intro: "Would you like me to heal your Pokémon?"

events.name: Breeder's Visit
events.intro: A breeder with a basket. "I can look after one for a bit."

success.text: It comes back happier and a little stronger.

events.name: Professor's Lab
events.intro: A professor waves you into a lab full of machines.

events.name: Gift from Mom
events.intro: A parcel addressed to you. "From Mom."

success.text: Money, medicine and a note: "Eat your vegetables."
You put it away. It's heavy… a Rare Candy!

events.name: Ranger Rescue
events.intro: A Ranger with a Capture Styler needs help freeing a trapped Pokémon.

success.text: Freed! It chooses to come with you.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Daycare Couple
events.intro: An old couple at a fence. "We'll raise one for you!"

success.text: It's grown while you were away!
They found an Egg! Keep it warm and it will hatch.

events.name: Lost Child
events.intro: Two preschoolers are crying.

events.name: Nurse Joy's Clinic
events.intro: A small clinic with a friendly doctor.

events.name: Kind Hiker
events.intro: A hiker offers trail mix.

success.text: You share a snack. Good vibes.

events.name: Wishing Well
events.intro: A stone well. Coins glint at the bottom.

events.name: Game Corner
events.intro: Slot reels spin under flashing lights.

success.text: You trade coins for a prize.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Rattling Chest
events.intro: Another chest. This one rattles a lot.

failure.text: A Mimic! It was a Pokémon all along!

success.text: You hear a Pokémon inside and leave it. A coin rolls out.

events.name: Coin Flip Gambler
events.intro: "Heads or tails? Double or nothing!"

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Lottery Booth
events.intro: A drum of numbered balls. "Try your luck!"

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Card Shark
events.intro: A harlequin shuffles a deck.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Crystal Ball
events.intro: A medium gazes into a crystal ball.

success.text: The gym leader's team appears in the glass.

events.name: Roulette of Fate
events.intro: A clown spins a giant wheel.

success.text: Big win: money and a Rare Candy!
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Pokémon Prize Wheel
events.intro: An idol presents a wheel of Pokémon.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Punching Bag
events.intro: A punching bag swings in the breeze.

events.name: Move Tutor
events.intro: A sage sits by an old scroll.

success.text: Your lead learns from the scroll.

events.name: Move Forgetter
events.intro: A teacher at a chalkboard. "Need to forget something?"

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Library
events.intro: Quiet shelves, full of Pokédex entries.

events.name: Gym Rat
events.intro: A triathlete waves from a bike.

events.name: Meditation Shrine
events.intro: A psychic floats above a mat.

events.name: Dragon's Den
events.intro: A Dragon Tamer holds out a gleaming scale.

success.text: You pass! The scale is yours.

events.name: Expert Breeder
events.intro: "I can teach your Pokémon an egg move."

success.text: A new trick from its parents!
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Weird Dream
events.intro: The screen fades. A ghost floats in your dream.

success.text: You wake with a gift in your hand.

failure.text: A nightmare. Your team sleeps badly.

events.name: Ruins of Alph
events.intro: Torchlight flickers over a stone puzzle.

success.text: The wall opens. An Unown floats out!

events.name: Haunted House
events.intro: The lights flicker. Something giggles upstairs.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Time-Travel Rift
events.intro: A glowing rift hangs in the air.

events.name: Meteorite Crash
events.intro: A crater, still smoking.

events.name: Mirage Island
events.intro: A shimmering island appears offshore.

success.text: A Pokémon of legend… in a strange form!
It fades. You feel lucky to have seen it.

events.name: Abandoned Lab
events.intro: Broken machines and scattered notes.

events.name: Shrine Maiden
events.intro: A shrine maiden sweeps beneath a red gate.

success.text: Money… and a chill down your spine.

events.name: Spooky Festival
events.intro: Jack-o'-lanterns light a parade.

events.name: Ghost Train
events.intro: A dark train waits at an empty platform.

success.text: A strange journey. You arrive stronger.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Strange Signal
events.intro: An antenna sparks. Something is calling.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Ash's Training
events.intro: "Hey! Wanna battle? Pikachu's all fired up!"

success.text: You learn a lot from him.

events.name: Champion Lunch
events.intro: A Champion waves you over to a picnic table.

events.name: Red on the Mountain
events.intro: A silent trainer stands in the snow.

events.name: Elesa's Photoshoot
events.intro: Cameras flash. "Strike a pose!"

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Iono's Stream
events.intro: "Hey hey! You're live on my stream!"

events.name: Kahili's Golf
events.intro: "Care for a round?"

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Professor's Time Machine
events.intro: A humming machine. "Shall we see the past… or future?"

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Giovanni's Offer
events.intro: "Join Team Rocket. I reward loyalty."

success.text: He hands you a fat envelope.

events.name: Lillie and Nebby
events.intro: A girl clutches a bag. "Please, help us!"

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Penny's Hack
events.intro: "I can… improve your Bag. Probably."

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Pokéfan Meetup
events.intro: Pokéfans gather to show off their favourites.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Fire-Breather's Show
events.intro: A Fire-Breather lights up the night.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Surf Rescue
events.intro: A surfer is caught in a rip current.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Flower Garden
events.intro: An Aroma Lady tends a bright garden.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Power Plant Fault
events.intro: Sparks fly from a broken generator.

success.text: Fixed! An Electric Pokémon was hiding inside.

events.name: Frozen Lake
events.intro: A frozen lake glitters. Something shines in the ice.

success.text: You grab it on the way!

events.name: Street Brawl
events.intro: Two trainers are about to fight.

events.name: Toxic Swamp
events.intro: Purple bubbles rise from a swamp.

success.text: A Poison Pokémon follows you out!
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Fossil Dig
events.intro: A hiker hands you a shovel.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Sky Race
events.intro: Bird Keepers line up for a race.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Mind Reader
events.intro: "Guess my card."

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Bug-Catching Contest
events.intro: "Catch the biggest bug!"

failure.text: A small one. It joins anyway.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Cave-In
events.intro: Rubble blocks the tunnel.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Graveyard Vigil
events.intro: Candles flicker over old graves.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Dragon Shrine
events.intro: An elder asks you a question about kindness.

events.name: Back-Alley Deal
events.intro: "Want something nobody else has?"

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Junkyard
events.intro: Piles of scrap metal.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Fairy Tea Party
events.intro: A tea party with Fairy Pokémon.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Pokémon Center
events.intro: A small Pokémon Center with a shop counter.

events.name: Berry Tree
events.intro: A lone berry tree.

events.name: Treasure Cache
events.intro: A buried box sticks out of the dirt.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Training Ground
events.intro: Tracks, weights and targets.

events.name: Villain Hideout
events.intro: A secret base hums behind a poster.

success.text: You grab a crate and run.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Rest Spot: Meadow
events.intro: A quiet meadow. Time to spend with your lead Pokémon.

success.text: Munch munch. It loves you more.

events.name: Rest Spot: Training Field
events.intro: An open field, perfect for practice.

failure.text: Just mud, but it had fun.

events.name: Rest Spot: Photo Corner
events.intro: A scenic spot with a camera stand.

events.name: Oak's Letter: The Sky Trio
events.intro: The letter leads to a cliff. Wings beat overhead: a legendary bird of Kanto.

success.text: It watches you leave. You feel blessed.

events.name: S.S. Ticket: The Ferry
events.intro: The S.S. Anne sounds its horn. "All aboard for the gym city!"

success.text: You step off right beside the gym, and the ship's shop is open.
The deck shop has fair prices.

events.name: Card Key: Silph Doors
events.intro: A Silph Co. door clicks open. A crate of prototypes sits inside.

events.name: Secret Key: Hidden Volcano
events.intro: The Secret Key opens a gate on Cinnabar's slope. Something hot stirs.

success.text: Old notes and a pouch of coins.

events.name: Lift Key: Rocket Hideout
events.intro: The lift drops to the Rocket hideout's vault floor.

events.name: Basement Key: Old Tunnels
events.intro: Under the Goldenrod basement, the tunnels rumble.

success.text: A rare Ground or Rock Pokémon!

events.name: Storage Key: The Warehouse
events.intro: Boxes from floor to ceiling. Some are labelled for you.

events.name: Suite Key: Luxury Suite
events.intro: A suite with soft beds and a view. Your team flops down.

events.name: Works Key: Power Plant
events.intro: The old power plant crackles. Sparks dance between the coils.

events.name: Room 1 Key: Abandoned Ship
events.intro: Cabin 1 creaks open. A dusty trunk sits under the porthole.

events.name: Room 2 Key: Abandoned Ship
events.intro: A sailor in cabin 2 jumps up. "A battle! Winner takes double!"

success.text: The sailor sends out his team!

events.name: Room 4 Key: Abandoned Ship
events.intro: Cabin 4 is cold. A shadow slides across the wall.

success.text: You slam the door. Your heart races.

events.name: Room 6 Key: The Scanner
events.intro: In cabin 6 you find a Scanner. A collector on deck offers a trade for it.

success.text: The collector hands over a treasure.

events.name: Galactic Key: Veilstone HQ
events.intro: Team Galactic's warehouse door slides open.

success.text: A grateful Pokémon follows you out.

events.name: Magma Emblem: The Hideout
events.intro: The emblem opens Team Magma's volcano base. Deep below, Groudon sleeps.

events.name: Red Chain: Spear Pillar
events.intro: The Red Chain glows at the top of Mt. Coronet. Time and space twist.

success.text: It watches you leave. You feel blessed.

events.name: Eon Ticket: Southern Island
events.intro: A small island. Two shapes circle above the tree.

success.text: It watches you leave. You feel blessed.

events.name: MysticTicket: Navel Rock
events.intro: Navel Rock. At the top a rainbow; at the bottom, deep water.

success.text: It watches you leave. You feel blessed.

events.name: AuroraTicket: Birth Island
events.intro: A triangle on Birth Island shifts as you step close.

success.text: It watches you leave. You feel blessed.

events.name: Old Sea Map: Faraway Island
events.intro: Tall grass on Faraway Island. Something pink giggles.

success.text: It watches you leave. You feel blessed.

events.name: Liberty Pass: Liberty Garden
events.intro: Under the lighthouse, a tiny Pokémon with a V on its head waits.

success.text: It watches you leave. You feel blessed.

events.name: Azure Flute: Hall of Origin
events.intro: You play the Azure Flute. Stairs of light rise into the sky.

success.text: It watches you leave. You feel blessed.

events.name: Dark Stone: Zekrom
events.intro: The Dark Stone crackles with black lightning.

success.text: It watches you leave. You feel blessed.

events.name: Light Stone: Reshiram
events.intro: The Light Stone burns white-hot in your hands.

success.text: It watches you leave. You feel blessed.

events.name: Magma Stone: Stark Mountain
events.intro: Deep in Stark Mountain, the lava bubbles around a steel shape.

success.text: It watches you leave. You feel blessed.

events.name: Rainbow Wing: Bell Tower
events.intro: The bells ring. A rainbow bird lands on the roof.

success.text: It watches you leave. You feel blessed.

events.name: Silver Wing: Whirl Islands
events.intro: Whirlpools roar. A silver shape rises from the sea.

success.text: It watches you leave. You feel blessed.

events.name: Tri-Pass: Sevii Ferry
events.intro: The Seagallop ferry can take you to one of three islands.

success.text: A rare Pokémon in the grass!

events.name: Rainbow Pass: All the Islands
events.intro: The Rainbow Pass covers every island. Shop, rest, then explore!

success.text: Market, springs, and now a rare Pokémon!

events.name: Contest Pass: Super Contest
events.intro: The Contest Pass gets you on stage. The crowd waits.

failure.text: A slip, but the crowd liked it.

events.name: Lost Property Office
events.intro: "Nobody ever comes back for these," the clerk sighs, waving at a shelf of keys and tickets.

success.text: One of these must open something.
"They say a ticket to a faraway island turned up once…"

events.name: The Old Collector
events.intro: An old man keeps a case of rare tickets and stones. "Prove yourself and pick one."

success.text: He hands you an old sea chart.

events.name: Ruins Dig Site
events.intro: Researchers dig at ancient ruins. Two stones glint in the dirt, one dark and one light.

events.name: The Lake Trio's Gift
events.intro: Three lights rise from three lakes and meet over your head. A red chain falls into your hand.

events.name: The Flute Maker
events.intro: A craftsman plays a blue flute. "This one opens the sky. It costs a lot."

success.text: A bell for a legendary bird.

events.name: Shady Emblem Seller
events.intro: "Psst. Want a Magma Emblem? Or a Galactic key? No questions asked."

events.name: Professor's Errand
events.intro: "Could you take this letter to an old friend? It might lead somewhere special."

events.name: Dark Deal
events.intro: A strange scientist offers a device. "Give me one Pokémon and I'll give you a legend… maybe."

success.text: The machine whirs. A powerful Pokémon steps out!

events.name: Safari Zone
events.intro: A gate to the Safari Zone. "Rare Pokémon inside, ₽500 entry!"

success.text: Something rare rustles in the tall grass!
A friendly Pokémon wanders up and follows you.

failure.text: It ate the bait and ran.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Teleporting Hijinks
events.intro: A glowing pad hums by the path. A sign reads "DO NOT STAND HERE".

success.text: Zap! You land much further down the road.

failure.text: Zap! You land in a nest of angry Psychic-types!

events.name: The Strong Stuff
events.intro: A Shuckle sits on a pile of fermented berry juice. It offers you a sip.

success.text: Your lead feels incredibly tough, if a bit slower.
The Shuckle hides in its shell!
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: An Offer You Can't Refuse
events.intro: A rich kid points at your Pokémon. "I'll pay a fortune for that one!"

success.text: A stack of cash. Your team looks at you funny.

events.name: Delibird-y
events.intro: Three Delibird waddle up with sacks. They want a present first.

success.text: They chirp happily and give you a berry bundle.

events.name: Absolute Avarice
events.intro: A huge Greedent sits on a hoard of berries. It glares at you.

success.text: Greedent is pleased and joins you!

events.name: Clowning Around
events.intro: A clown and his Mr. Mime block the road. "Laugh, or battle!"

events.name: Part-Timer
events.intro: A shop needs a hand. Your Pokémon could help for pay.

events.name: Dancing Lessons
events.intro: An Oricorio dances by the road. It wants a partner.

success.text: A great dance! It joins your team.

failure.text: You tripped. It laughs and flies away.

success.text: Your team learned a few moves.

events.name: Global Trade Station
events.intro: A trading booth links to trainers around the world.

success.text: A Pokémon from far away arrives!
Someone sends a held item back.

events.name: Fun and Games!
events.intro: A carnival game: knock out the Wobbuffet in three turns to win!

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Bug-Type Superfan
events.intro: "Bugs are the BEST! Show me yours!"

success.text: "WOW!" He gives you his best stuff.

events.name: An Unlikely Ally
events.intro: A strong wild Pokémon fights off a gang of others. It looks hurt.

success.text: You fight side by side against the gang!
It nods at you, healed. It decides to come along.

events.name: Trash to Treasure
events.intro: A huge heap of junk. Something shiny pokes out. Something smelly guards it.

failure.text: Just junk, and now you smell.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Field Trip
events.intro: A teacher and her class want to see a Pokémon move in action.

success.text: "Amazing!" The class gives you a gift.

failure.text: A bit clumsy, but they clapped.

success.text: "So pretty!" They give you a gift.

events.name: Berry Merchant
events.intro: A cart full of fresh berries. "Two for ₽400!"

choices.label: Trade a held item for five

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Evolution Stone Seller
events.intro: "Fire, water, thunder, leaf… pick a stone, ₽1200!"

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Poké Ball Outlet
events.intro: Factory seconds: slightly dented Poké Balls, cheap!

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Snack Stand
events.intro: Fresh Water, Soda Pop, Lava Cookies… your team stares hungrily.

success.text: A feast! Your team loves you.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Fossil Trader
events.intro: "Ancient fossils! Revive them at any lab!"

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Move Tutor Stall
events.intro: "I teach moves for money. Your lead could learn a lot."

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Mystery Box Seller
events.intro: "Mystery boxes! Could be anything! ₽700!"

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Scrap Buyer
events.intro: "I buy anything! Anything at all!"

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Lucky Charm Shop
events.intro: Charms, trinkets and good-luck pendants line the shelves.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Herbalist
events.intro: Bitter herbs that heal fast. "Cheap, but your Pokémon won't like the taste."

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Ferry Ticket Booth
events.intro: "Express ferry to the gym town! ₽1500!"

success.text: You step off near the gym.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Triple Trouble
events.intro: Three kids challenge you at once. "All of us! Right now!"

events.name: Veteran's Challenge
events.intro: An old Veteran nods. "Show me what you've learned."

events.name: Type Specialist
events.intro: A trainer who uses only one type wants a battle.

events.name: Speed Trial
events.intro: A racer dares you: "Beat my time through the course!"

events.name: Boulder Push
events.intro: A Hiker dares your team to push a huge boulder up a hill.

events.name: Quiz Master
events.intro: "Answer my three questions about Pokémon!"

events.name: Beauty Pageant
events.intro: A stage, lights and judges. Your lead is entered!

events.name: Pokémon Marathon
events.intro: Runners and their Pokémon line up at the start.

failure.text: You finish last, tired but proud.

events.name: Gym Trainer Practice
events.intro: A gym trainer is practising nearby. "Want to see what the leader uses?"

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Mirror Match
events.intro: A trainer who looks like you, with a team that looks like yours…

events.name: Little League
events.intro: Kids practise battling. They want a coach.

events.name: Champion Cup Qualifier
events.intro: A qualifier for a big tournament. Only strong teams enter.

events.name: Sleeping Hollow
events.intro: A hollow where wild Pokémon nap in a pile.

events.name: Migrating Flock
events.intro: A flock of bird Pokémon passes overhead.

events.name: Tide Pools
events.intro: Small pools on the rocks are full of tiny Water Pokémon.

events.name: Glowing Mushrooms
events.intro: Mushrooms glow blue in the dark woods.

events.name: Rumbling Herd
events.intro: The ground shakes. A herd charges down the valley.

events.name: A Shiny Glint
events.intro: Something sparkles in the tall grass. Could it be…?

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Pokémon Playground
events.intro: Young wild Pokémon play tag in a clearing.

events.name: Alpha Pokémon
events.intro: A huge Pokémon with red eyes stomps through the clearing.

events.name: Nesting Ground
events.intro: Parent Pokémon guard their eggs. One egg rolls toward you.

success.text: It wriggles in your bag. It will hatch soon!

events.name: Lightning Storm
events.intro: Thunder cracks. Electric Pokémon dance in the storm.

events.name: Lake Legend
events.intro: Mist rises from the lake. A blue shape runs across the water.

events.name: Wild Tea Party
events.intro: Fairy Pokémon sit around a tiny table with teacups.

success.text: A teacup Pokémon hops into your bag.

events.name: Rocket Roadblock
events.intro: "Team Rocket toll! ₽500 or battle!"

success.text: They laugh and let you pass.

events.name: Team Aqua's Flood
events.intro: Team Aqua is flooding a valley "for the Pokémon"!

success.text: You get everyone to high ground.

events.name: Team Magma's Drill
events.intro: A giant drill digs into the mountain. Team Magma laughs.

events.name: Galactic Lecture
events.intro: A Galactic speaker preaches about a "new world without spirit".

success.text: Creepy, but you learn their plan.

events.name: Plasma Protest
events.intro: "Free your Pokémon!" Team Plasma waves signs at you.

choices.label: Show how happy your team is

events.name: Flare Boutique
events.intro: An exclusive boutique run by Team Flare. "Only the beautiful may shop."

events.name: Team Skull Graffiti
events.intro: Team Skull is spray-painting a Pokémon Center. "Yo, whatchu lookin' at?"

events.name: Team Yell Blockade
events.intro: Team Yell won't let anyone near Marnie's gym. They chant loudly.

events.name: Macro Cosmos Lab
events.intro: A Macro Cosmos lab drains energy from wild Pokémon.

events.name: Team Star Heist
events.intro: Team Star is "borrowing" Poké Balls from a school.

events.name: Counterfeit Items
events.intro: "Genuine Leftovers, only ₽300!" They look suspiciously plastic.

events.name: Poacher Camp
events.intro: Hunters keep caged Pokémon in their camp.

choices.label: Sneak in and open the cages

success.text: They all escape! One stays with you.

events.name: Lost Wallet
events.intro: A wallet lies on the path, full of cash.

events.name: Stuck Pokémon
events.intro: A Pokémon is stuck in a fence and crying.

success.text: It nuzzles you and follows along.

failure.text: It runs off, but it's free.

events.name: Old Man's Tale
events.intro: An old man by a campfire wants to share a story.

success.text: A tale of a legendary bird. You feel wiser.
He laughs and gives you a gift.

events.name: Bakery Gift
events.intro: A baker is giving out free treats to trainers.

success.text: Your team helped knead the dough.

events.name: Volunteer Cleanup
events.intro: Volunteers clean a polluted river.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Mom Calls
events.intro: Your phone rings. It's Mom! "Are you eating well?"

events.name: Rescue Team Call
events.intro: A Rescue Team asks for help finding a lost hiker in the fog.

success.text: You find the hiker! The team rewards you.

failure.text: No luck, but the team thanks you.

choices.label: Battle the wild Pokémon blocking the path

events.name: Pokémon Ranger
events.intro: A Ranger offers to check your team.

success.text: She marks a spot on your map.

events.name: Old Lady at the Crossing
events.intro: An old lady can't cross the busy road.

success.text: She gives you a lucky charm.

choices.label: Have a Pokémon carry her bags

events.name: Daycare Drop-In
events.intro: The daycare man waves. "Leave one with us a while?"

choices.label: Leave the lead for a bit

events.name: Stray Kitten
events.intro: A hungry little cat Pokémon mews at you.

events.name: Slot Machine
events.intro: A dusty slot machine blinks "777!"

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Dice Game
events.intro: "Roll higher than me and double your money!"

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Ball Toss
events.intro: Throw a ball into the basket from far away.

events.name: Scratch Card
events.intro: "Scratch cards, ₽200 each!"

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Voltorb Flip
events.intro: A board of cards. Some hide coins, some hide Voltorb!

events.name: Egg Hunt
events.intro: Painted eggs are hidden all over a park.

events.name: Fishing Derby
events.intro: A fishing contest! Biggest catch wins.

events.name: Three Doors
events.intro: Three doors. One has treasure, one has a Pokémon, one has nothing.

events.name: Ghost's Gamble
events.intro: A grinning Gengar shuffles cards. "Pick one, if you dare."

success.text: The Ace! Gengar bows and gives you a prize.

failure.text: The Joker! Gengar curses your team.

events.name: Coin Fountain
events.intro: A fountain full of coins. A sign says "Make a wish".

events.name: Waterfall Training
events.intro: A roaring waterfall. Trainers meditate under it.

events.name: Mountain Climb
events.intro: A steep path up the mountain. The view must be amazing.

success.text: What a view! Your team grows.

events.name: Sparring Partner
events.intro: A Black Belt's Pokémon wants to spar with yours.

events.name: Study Hall
events.intro: A quiet room full of Pokémon books.

events.name: Yoga Retreat
events.intro: A calm retreat for trainers and Pokémon alike.

events.name: Obstacle Course
events.intro: Ropes, tunnels and jumps. A record time wins a prize.

events.name: EV Coach
events.intro: "I train one stat at a time. Pick your focus."

events.name: Candy Cache
events.intro: A hidden jar of Rare Candies behind a rock!

choices.label: Give them all to the lead

events.name: Bond Ceremony
events.intro: A shrine where trainers and Pokémon promise to stay together.

success.text: Your bond feels stronger than ever.

events.name: Ice Training
events.intro: A frozen lake perfect for slide practice.

events.name: Unown Wall
events.intro: Letters on a cave wall shift and spell a word.

success.text: "FRIEND". An Unown floats out to join you.

events.name: Time Capsule
events.intro: A buried box labelled "Open in 20 years". It's been 30.

success.text: Old Poké Balls and a note.
Someone will be happy one day.

events.name: Ancient Tablet
events.intro: A stone tablet shows a giant Pokémon shaping the land.

success.text: The tablet glows. A guardian appears!

events.name: Ghost Ship
events.intro: A ship drifts in the fog. Nobody is on deck.

success.text: A chill runs down your spine.

events.name: Meteor Shower
events.intro: Shooting stars fill the sky. One lands nearby!

success.text: You wish for your team's health.

events.name: Lost Journal
events.intro: A soggy journal of a trainer who walked this road long ago.

events.name: Distortion
events.intro: The world flips upside down. A shadow with six wings watches.

events.name: Mysterious Statue
events.intro: An old statue of a Pokémon nobody recognizes.

success.text: Its eyes glint. You feel lucky.

events.name: Dream Mist
events.intro: Pink mist drifts by. Your team starts dreaming of the future.

success.text: You glimpse the gym leader's team in the dream.

events.name: Cursed Doll
events.intro: A creepy doll sits on a bench. Its zipper mouth moves.

events.name: Ancient Seed
events.intro: A seed that glows warm, found in old ruins.

success.text: It sprouts instantly into a berry bush!
It hatches! It was a Pokémon all along.

events.name: Brock's Cooking
events.intro: A friendly breeder is cooking stew for every Pokémon in sight.

events.name: Gym Leader's Swim
events.intro: A Water gym leader swims laps. "Race me!"

success.text: You won! She hands you a prize.

failure.text: She laps you twice. Still fun.

events.name: Blue's Taunt
events.intro: "Smell ya later, loser!" Blue blocks the road.

success.text: "Hey! Don't ignore me!" You feel calm.

events.name: Roark's Mine
events.intro: A gym leader digs in the mine. "Help me dig, and we'll split the finds!"

events.name: Snowball Fight
events.intro: "Snowball fight! Focus, focus, focus!"

events.name: Museum Tour
events.intro: A gym leader runs a museum. "Want the full tour?"

events.name: Artist's Studio
events.intro: An artist paints Bug Pokémon. "Pose for me?"

events.name: Master Dojo
events.intro: A cheerful old master. "Train with me for a day?"

events.name: Salaryman's Lunch
events.intro: A tired man eats rice balls. "Normal day, normal lunch."

success.text: He shares a rice ball. Very normal. Very nice.

events.name: A Bitter Rival
events.intro: A gloomy boy glares at you. "I'll get stronger than you. I have to."

events.name: Little Steel Master
events.intro: A tiny girl with a big hammer. "Wanna play?"

success.text: "Yay!" She gives you a shiny bolt.

events.name: Sandstorm
events.intro: A sandstorm blows across the desert route.

success.text: Sand everywhere, but you made it.

events.name: Heatwave
events.intro: The sun burns hot. Your team pants.

events.name: Blizzard Pass
events.intro: A mountain pass buried in snow.

events.name: Foggy Moor
events.intro: Thick fog. You can't see your feet.

failure.text: You walk in circles for hours.

events.name: Rainbow Bridge
events.intro: After the rain, a rainbow arcs over the route.

events.name: Hot Spring
events.intro: Steam rises from a natural hot spring. Your team runs in.

success.text: A quiet chat in the steam.

events.name: Starry Campsite
events.intro: A campsite under the stars. Your lead curls up beside you.

events.name: Flower Field
events.intro: Flowers as far as you can see. Your lead rolls in them.

events.name: Broken Bridge
events.intro: The bridge ahead is broken. The river below is wild.

success.text: Good as new! Travellers thank you.
A Water-type lives in the river!

events.name: Lighthouse
events.intro: The lighthouse lamp is out. Its Ampharos looks sick.

success.text: The light shines again! The keeper rewards you.

choices.label: Charge the lamp with your team

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Cherry Blossoms
events.intro: Pink petals fall everywhere. A festival is going on.

events.name: Volcano Rim
events.intro: The edge of an active volcano. Lava bubbles below.

success.text: A Fire-type rises from the lava!

events.name: Crystal Cave
events.intro: A cave of glowing crystals.

events.name: Desert Oasis
events.intro: Palm trees and a pool of fresh water in the desert.

events.name: Ancient Forest
events.intro: Huge old trees. Time feels slower here.

failure.text: Only the wind. You feel at peace.

events.name: Stormy Sea
events.intro: Huge waves crash. A boat is stuck on the rocks.

success.text: Everyone is safe! The captain rewards you.
A sea Pokémon surfs beside you!

events.name: Moonlit Path
events.intro: A full moon lights the path. Fairy Pokémon dance in a circle.

success.text: You feel light as a feather.

events.name: Abandoned Power Plant
events.intro: Sparks fly in an old power plant.

events.name: It Doesn't Want to Fight…
events.intro: A wild Pokémon trembles in the grass. It is frightened, or guarding something. It does not want to fight.

success.text: It fights back with everything it has!
You retreat. It watches you go, calmer.
It eats the berry and relaxes. It leaves you a small gift.
You find its hidden nest and learn something about its kind.

failure.text: It startles and bolts into the grass.

events.name: It Saw What You Did…
events.intro: A Pokémon at the edge of the path has been watching you for a long time. It saw how you treated others on this road.

success.text: It remembers your kindness and shows you a hidden cache.
It remembers your cruelty. It is not alone!
It cannot say, but it follows you for a while and warms to you.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: This Place Remembers…
events.intro: You have been somewhere like this before. The ground, the air and the old stones seem to remember the battles fought here.

success.text: Something was left behind from an earlier battle.

failure.text: Only dust and the echo of old footsteps.

success.text: The tracks lead you to a quieter path.
Your team feels the history of this place and grows closer.

events.name: A Researcher Recognizes Something
events.intro: A researcher stops dead and stares at your party. One of your Pokémon is a legendary form she has only read about. "Please," she says. "Let me record it."

success.text: She studies it carefully and funds a permanent research unlock.
"Then I will have to see it fight!" She sends out her own team.
You strike a better deal: research, and a stronger reward draft.

failure.text: She sees through the bluff and leaves in a huff.

events.name: A Researcher Recognizes Something
events.intro: A researcher stops dead and stares at your party. One of your Pokémon is a mythical form she has only read about. "Please," she says. "Let me record it."

success.text: She studies it carefully and funds a permanent research unlock.
"Then I will have to see it fight!" She sends out her own team.
You strike a better deal: research, and a stronger reward draft.

failure.text: She sees through the bluff and leaves in a huff.

events.name: An Old Face on the Road
events.intro: Someone you have fought more than once is sitting on a fence by the road, waiting. "Not a battle today. I want to see how far you have come."

success.text: You swap training tips. Your team grows.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Two Who Understand Each Other
events.intro: Two of your Pokémon have drifted away from the group and sit together, watching the sunset without a word.

success.text: The whole team feels closer for it.
Some things are better unobserved. They return refreshed.

events.name: A Signal From the Unknown
events.intro: A strange signal pulses from somewhere off the road. This region keeps its secrets, and this is one of them.

success.text: You find a hidden cache and a record of something very old.

failure.text: Nothing. Only static, and the feeling of being watched.

success.text: You note the frequency for later study.
A passing scholar explains and rewards your map.

events.name: Smoke on the Horizon
events.intro: A factory on the edge of town has gone wrong. Smoke is rolling over the fields and the workers are waving for help.

success.text: You pitch in at once. People remember it, and some of them promise to stand with you.
You gather what the region needs most. The trouble eases a little.

failure.text: You leave it be and walk on.

success.text: You are not the only one who walks on. The trouble keeps growing, but a grateful merchant pays you for your silence.

events.name: The River Is Rising
events.intro: The river has burst its banks. Families are carrying what they can to higher ground.

success.text: You pitch in at once. People remember it, and some of them promise to stand with you.
You gather what the region needs most. The trouble eases a little.

failure.text: You leave it be and walk on.

success.text: You are not the only one who walks on. The trouble keeps growing, but a grateful merchant pays you for your silence.

events.name: Something Is Making Pokémon Sick
events.intro: Pokémon across the region are coming down with the same fever. The local ranger looks exhausted.

success.text: You pitch in at once. People remember it, and some of them promise to stand with you.
You gather what the region needs most. The trouble eases a little.

failure.text: You leave it be and walk on.

success.text: You are not the only one who walks on. The trouble keeps growing, but a grateful merchant pays you for your silence.

events.name: The Lights Went Out
events.intro: Every light in the next town is dark. A stranger stands at the generator: "Whatever it is, it is getting worse."

success.text: You pitch in at once. People remember it, and some of them promise to stand with you.
You gather what the region needs most. The trouble eases a little.

failure.text: You leave it be and walk on.

success.text: You are not the only one who walks on. The trouble keeps growing, but a grateful merchant pays you for your silence.

events.name: They Heard You Were Here
events.intro: A rival you have fought more than once is waiting at the town gate, team at full strength. "Whatever this is, you will not face it alone. Not again."

success.text: You stand together. Your Pokémon feel the difference.

events.name: The Rival Gauntlet
events.intro: A hand-painted sign on the wall: "Everyone you have ever beaten wants a word." Rivals you have crossed paths with are lining up, each with the team they have trained since.

success.text: Word spreads fast. One rival will meet you on each of the next stops, in order of how dangerous they are. Beat them all for a big purse.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Rival Circuit
events.intro: A banner stretches across the plaza: the Rival Circuit. Trainers you have crossed paths with are signing up. The entry fee is ₽300, and the bracket runs over the next stages.

success.text: You are in. Your first match comes at the next stop.
You cheer from the crowd and learn how the best of them fight.

events.name: Circuit: Quarterfinal
events.intro: Your first match. A lively crowd fills the stands.

success.text: The crowd roars as the match begins.
You hand back your number. The bracket carries on without you.

events.name: Circuit: Semifinal
events.intro: The field has thinned. Your opponent has clearly studied your last match.

success.text: The crowd roars as the match begins.
You hand back your number. The bracket carries on without you.

events.name: Circuit: The Final
events.intro: The final. The best of the circuit stands across from you, and the whole plaza has gone quiet.

success.text: The crowd roars as the match begins.
You hand back your number. The bracket carries on without you.

events.name: Oak's Parcel
events.intro: A clerk at the Poké Mart waves. "Is that parcel for Professor Oak? He told us to expect it!"

events.name: A Letter to Deliver
events.intro: A shopkeeper reads the address on your letter and gasps. "That is for me!"

success.text: He pays you and tells everyone about your kindness.

events.name: A Parcel for the Nurse
events.intro: The healer at the clinic eyes your parcel. "I have been waiting for that!"

success.text: She gives you something from her shelf.

events.name: Devon Goods
events.intro: A Devon Corp. agent is waiting. "Those goods! Let me return the favour at half price."

success.text: A rare piece from Devon Corp.

events.name: The Scanner Collector
events.intro: A collector at the dock spots your Scanner. "I will trade you something fine for it."

events.name: The Gold Teeth
events.intro: The old Safari warden is tapping his jaw. "My teeth! You found my gold teeth!"

events.name: Gram 1
events.intro: A Gram clerk looks up. "Gram 1! One piece of the set."

events.name: Gram 2
events.intro: The clerk's friend smiles. "Gram 2! You are kind to bring it."

events.name: Gram 3
events.intro: Both clerks stand together. "Gram 3! With the other two, the set is complete."

choices.label: Deliver the last Gram (after Grams 1 and 2)

success.text: The whole set is theirs, and they pay handsomely.
You walk away with a lighter heart.

events.name: The Broken Machine
events.intro: A shop's register is jammed. "If only I had that machine part!"

success.text: The shop reopens, and the owner knocks the price down for you.

events.name: The Lost Item
events.intro: The Lost and Found counter spots the item in your bag. "Someone has been looking for that."

events.name: The Data Card
events.intro: A researcher scans your Data Card. "This helps the whole Pokédex project."

events.name: The Odd Keystone
events.intro: The Odd Keystone hums. 108 spirits whisper from inside it.

success.text: A Spiritomb follows you out of the mist.

events.name: The Meteorite
events.intro: The Meteorite shakes. A Deoxys in your party glows.

success.text: Deoxys changes to its Attack Forme!
Deoxys changes to its Defense Forme!
Deoxys changes to its Speed Forme!

events.name: The Dark Stone Fusion
events.intro: Kyurem and Zekrom call to each other.

success.text: Kyurem fuses with Zekrom into Black Kyurem!

events.name: The Light Stone Fusion
events.intro: Kyurem and Reshiram call to each other.

success.text: Kyurem fuses with Reshiram into White Kyurem!

events.name: The Reveal Glass: Tornadus
events.intro: The mirror shows Tornadus as it truly is.

events.name: The Reveal Glass: Thundurus
events.intro: The mirror shows Thundurus as it truly is.

events.name: The Reveal Glass: Landorus
events.intro: The mirror shows Landorus as it truly is.

events.name: The Haunted Mansion
events.intro: One window of the old mansion glows orange. Something giggles behind the door.

success.text: Behind a painting you find a clue, and a Spooky friend.

failure.text: A ghost leaps from the wardrobe!

success.text: A voice whispers a clue and slips you a charm.

events.name: The Pumpkin Patch
events.intro: Rows of carved pumpkins flicker. One of them blinks.

success.text: It was a Spooky Pokémon all along!

failure.text: Just a pumpkin… with a clue carved inside.

success.text: Your team laughs the night away.

events.name: The Candle Vigil
events.intro: A circle of candles burns in the dark. One of them is watching you.

success.text: The watching candle hops into your bag.
The candles flare up and attack!

events.name: The Lost Spirit
events.intro: A little teacup spirit floats in circles, lost.

success.text: It thanks you with two clues.
It leads you to its angry friends!

events.name: Trick or Treat!
events.intro: Costumed kids hold out their bags. "Trick or treat!"

success.text: They share a clue they found.

events.name: The Moonlit Graveyard
events.intro: Someone is digging by the old gate, carrying a ghostly beam.

success.text: You dig up a clue and a rare treat.
A Spooky Timburr swings its beam!

events.name: The Pumpkin King
events.intro: A towering figure with a lantern head blocks the road. "Only the brave pass my patch!"

success.text: The Pumpkin King summons his court!
He takes it and grumbles. A clue falls from his cape.

events.name: The Midnight Parade
events.intro: At midnight the Hex Coven leads the last parade of Spooky Season.

success.text: The Coven calls every ghost in town!
The parade glows past. You note a clue.

events.name: The Berry Fair
events.intro: Farmers show off the biggest berries of the year.

success.text: First prize, and a farmer's tip.

failure.text: Second place still gets a berry and a tip.

events.name: The Gift Exchange
events.intro: Under a glowing tree, trainers swap wrapped gifts.

success.text: A cozy surprise, and a tag with a clue.

events.name: The Frost King
events.intro: A snow worker crowned with icicles challenges every passer-by.

success.text: The Frost King's team storms in!
He laughs and lets you pass.

events.name: The Countdown
events.intro: Fireworks wait for midnight. A trainer wants one last battle of the year.

success.text: A bright start. You make a wish.

events.name: The Lantern Walk
events.intro: Red lanterns line the street. A dragon dance winds between them.

success.text: Your wish floats up with a clue.

events.name: The Friendship Picnic
events.intro: Blankets, sweets and Pokémon everywhere. Someone left you a seat.

success.text: Your team has never been closer.
A new friend wants to come along.

events.name: The Anniversary Parade
events.intro: A parade of every kind of Pokémon marches through town.

success.text: The crowd cheers for your partner.
The organisers pay you and share a clue.

events.name: The Egg Hunt
events.intro: Painted eggs are hidden all over the meadow.

success.text: A basket full of eggs and clues!

failure.text: Just one egg, but it counts.

choices.label: Help the little ones find theirs

events.name: The Bloom Guardian
events.intro: A huge flower Pokémon guards the first bloom of spring.

events.name: The Big Cleanup
events.intro: Volunteers are clearing litter from a riverbank.

events.name: The Beach Tournament
events.intro: A sandcastle stadium hosts the summer's biggest beach battle.

events.name: The Meteor Watch
events.intro: Stargazers lie in the grass. A meteor streaks overhead.

success.text: Where it landed: a shard and a clue.

failure.text: Gone, but you mapped where it fell.

events.name: The Academy Exam
events.intro: The Trainer Academy holds an open exam on the road.

success.text: The examiner sends out a team!

events.name: Trapped in the Vines
events.intro: A Pokémon is tangled in thick vines and cries out weakly.

success.text: It nuzzles your hand and follows you for a while.

failure.text: The vines are too tight. You free it, but it flees at once.

success.text: A passing ranger frees it and thanks you.
You decide not to stop. Nothing happens.

events.name: An Injured Pokémon
events.intro: A hurt wild Pokémon lies beside the path, breathing hard.

success.text: It recovers, leaves a berry at your feet and vanishes into the grass.
It watches you go. You feel fine about it.

events.name: Claw Marks and Broken Branches
events.intro: Deep claw marks score the trees and the grass is flattened. Something big claims this ground.

success.text: The detour costs you time but nothing else.
You learn its habits and avoid it, and note the signs.
A territorial Pokémon charges out of the brush!

events.name: A Disturbed Habitat
events.intro: Nests lie overturned and wild Pokémon keep their distance. Someone has been here.

success.text: Fresh boot prints lead off through the trees. You note them down.
You walk on. The forest stays quiet.

events.name: The Poacher Camp
events.intro: The tracks end at a hidden camp. Cages of frightened Pokémon sit beside a smouldering fire.

success.text: The cages open. One of the Pokémon stays by your side.
The poachers send out a savage Pokémon.
A ranger team arrives later and thanks you.

events.name: The Habitat Recovers
events.intro: The grove you helped is alive again. The Pokémon here remember you.

success.text: A rare Pokémon steps out of the grove, calm and curious.
The Pokémon bring you berries and keep you company.
